name: WorldRenderer Multi-Pass Pipeline
definition: A multi-pass Metal pipeline that draws five world layers (Structure, Object, Zone, IoT, Agent) into a single MTKView-backed drawable, designed for M1 Pro 16-core GPU with instanced rendering, frustum culling, LOD, and depth fog.
summary: The WorldRenderer Multi-Pass Pipeline is a GPU rendering engine for VoxelKit that composites five world layers into a single image using Metal, distinguished by CPU-side frustum culling and hardware-aware presets.
